text: Cause I never gave a what do you wanna be when you finally grow up That's a question I never really got I'm gonna be me if you like it or not That's how I used to think until I finally thought that it's not that easy Cause life brings a lot of change and hard pains and certain things that change your mind frame and rearrange your mentality What my nephew and niece think about me is more important than your hourly salary If you don't get it yet then you will Maybe you won't but maybe you will
